input: Request a LinkedIn skills endorsement from a colleague

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which specific skill(s) to request endorsements for determines how targeted and focused the message needs to be — endorsing one core skill vs. several changes the ask entirely.
The relationship with the colleague (close friend, distant coworker, former manager) heavily shapes the tone and formality of the request message.
Understanding why the endorsement is needed right now (job search, promotion, profile boost) clarifies the urgency and helps frame a compelling reason in the request.
The channel used to make the request (LinkedIn message, email, text, in person) affects how the message is drafted and delivered.
The desired tone (warm and casual vs. professional and formal) determines the writing style of the outreach message.
Whether the user has a deadline (e.g., a job application closing soon) affects how quickly the task must be completed and how direct the ask should be.
Knowing whether the user wants help drafting the actual message, or just a step-by-step action plan, defines what a fully completed task looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Request a LinkedIn skills endorsement from a colleague
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to reach out to a colleague to ask them to endorse one or more specific skills on their LinkedIn profile.

questions.title: Which specific skill(s) do you want endorsed?
questions.description: Identify the exact LinkedIn skill(s) the user wants the colleague to endorse, as this focuses the entire request.

questions.title: How well do you know this colleague?
questions.description: Determine the closeness of the relationship (e.g., close friend, regular coworker, former manager, brief acquaintance) to calibrate tone and approach.

questions.title: Why do you need this endorsement right now?
questions.description: Understand the driving motivation (active job search, profile refresh, upcoming performance review) to frame a genuine and persuasive reason in the message.

questions.title: Which channel will you use to send the request?
questions.description: Clarify whether the request will be sent via LinkedIn direct message, email, text, or made in person, as this shapes the format and length of the message.

questions.title: Should the message feel casual or formally professional?
questions.description: Establish the preferred tone so the drafted message matches the user's natural voice and the nature of the relationship.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which you need the endorsement?
questions.description: Find out if time pressure exists (e.g., a job application deadline) to determine urgency and whether a follow-up reminder should be planned.

questions.title: Do you want a drafted message or just action steps?
questions.description: Determine whether the user's end goal is a ready-to-send written request, or a checklist of steps to handle the outreach themselves.
